conditions.displayName: Error in an active CDC stream

documentation.content:
Datastream emitted an ERROR for CDC stream ${log.extracted_label.stream_id}. Review its current state, replication errors and source connectivity.

https://console.cloud.google.com/datastream/streams?project=fxr-analytics

This policy detects new error log entries. It does not detect a silently stalled stream, missing logs or replication lag. Automatic incident closure is not proof of recovery.
